prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing desktop pet workspace...", "Your pet companion is coming to life on your desktop!"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your companion is now active on your desktop. Click and drag or right-click anytime to interact.", "Start Interacting", "Desktop Active"]
2: ["Preview Companion Style", "See how your desktop pet will look and move on your screen.", "Confirm Appearance"]
3: ["Save Your Companion's Progress", "Sign in to keep your pet safely saved to your cloud profile so you never lose progress when logging in from another device.", "Cloud Sync Protection Enabled"]
4: ["Choose Your Desktop Friend", "Swipe or click to view available desktop pet companions.", "Ready to Adopt"]
5: ["Protect Your Pet With Cloud Restore", "Connecting your account ensures your pet's memory, items, and settings remain safe whenever you log back in."]
6: ["We will chime when your pet is live on your desktop!"]
7: ["Estimated build time remaining"]
8: ["Recommended - Quick 1-Min Adoption"]
9: ["Welcome to your new desktop world! Let's find your perfect companion."]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency or pressure by framing adoption with a time limit
